sense.text:
“This matter is by the decree of the watchers, and the demand by the word of the holy ones: to the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men”. To understand God’s plan, this is where it begins: the most High God is the one that ruleth in the kingdom of men. What does that mean? The things the presidents and the leaders of the earth are doing, the Lord is behind all of it, even when what they are doing is evil.

He “giveth it to whomsoever he will.” He is the one that made Trump president, and the one that caused Biden to steal the presidency from Trump the time before. And when you read prophecy, we know who he gave the last kingdom to: the Europeans. One time Iran had the earth. One time the ancient Babylonians ruled. One time the East Indians ruled. Now it is given to the white man, and he is the one ruling the earth today.

He “setteth up over it the basest of men.” The people ruling the earth today are the basest of men. The rightful rulers of this earth are not ruling.

precepts.why:
“Man’s goings are of the Lord; how can a man then understand his own way?” People ask why they do the things they do, why this president does this, why that person does that. The reason is that the Lord is making men do these things. The Lord will put the spirit on a man to hate that person, to bomb children, to colonize and conquer. A man cannot understand his own way. The white man doesn’t understand why he does the things he does; he does them because he is the wicked of the earth.

Read on: “It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.” It is a trap for a man to devour that which is holy, and the holy is the 12 tribes of Israel. He destroys them, and afterwards vows to make enquiry.

So what the rulers do in Daniel 4:17 is of the Lord: the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and men’s goings are of him.

“The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever.” God’s counsel is the Bible; that is where you find it. God’s plan, written in this Bible, is going to stand forever, and nobody is changing it. It doesn’t matter if it hurts your feelings, if you don’t like what it says, or if you don’t believe in what the Bible says. God’s counsel is going to stand.

“The thoughts of his heart to all generations”: what God is going to do in the future is all written in this book. The kingdom the Most High gives to whomsoever he will is given by a counsel no one can change.

“I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me, Declaring the end from the beginning.” God declared his plans for this earth in the beginning: what is going to happen in these times we are living in right now.

“And from ancient times the things that are not yet done.” He let us know from ancient times the things that were not yet done. Moses prophesied in Deuteronomy 28:68 that the children of Israel would go into slavery on ships, and that was not done until the 1400s, when it started; then they went to Africa and ran us up in Africa too. The transatlantic slave trade did not begin in the 1600s. It began before that, when the so-called white men started conquering.

“Saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure.” His counsel is God’s plan, and it is going to stand. What God wants to do, his pleasure, his will, he is going to do, and nobody can stop him. What is written in this Bible is going to come to pass, whether you believe it or not.

sense.text: Some came and told Christ “of the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices.” Brothers were sacrificing unto God, and Pilate, a Roman, a white man, came and killed them while they were doing it, and mingled their blood with their sacrifices.

“Suppose ye that these Galileans were sinners above all the Galileans, because they suffered such things?” That question is for today. Charlie Kirk was assassinated about two weeks ago, and online a lot of people are rejoicing and laughing, saying it’s good he died, God killed him. Do you think he was worse than a lot of you that were rejoicing over his death? Because he suffered such things, because he was shot, do you think he was the worst amongst Esau?

“I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.” Every one of you is going to perish: you homosexuals out there rejoicing, you transgenders, you brothers and sisters that worship the beast and follow Christianity, and you Israelites still in the midst of your sin, you blacks and Hispanics still in the midst of your sin, rejoicing over another man’s death. You say that person is wicked, but unless you change, you are going to suffer the same thing when Christ returns.
“Those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them”: “think ye that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem?” They were not more wicked than all men.

“I tell you, Nay: but, except ye repent, ye shall all likewise perish.” All of you are going to perish.

So we are not mourning his death, and neither are we going to rejoice over it. We understand what the Lord is doing, and we have to let the Lord do what he is doing, because the Most High rules in the kingdom of men. Because of his death a lot of things have started happening, and that is the Lord at work. Things are about to get crazy for you dumb black people out there rejoicing his death and following these liberals.

“They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily”. Snares are traps. “They say, Who shall see them?” Who sees us? This is the secret society, the people setting up these traps and running the world behind the scenes, the shadow government.

Learn to use your spiritual eyes with what you see on the news; the news was always set up to control what you think. Charlie Kirk became too big. If he had run for president he would have won, that is how much white people loved him. He said the wrong things to the wrong people, about the Israeli government and the genocide, and too many people followed him for the elites to let him say it; as head of Turning Point USA he could change the minds of the young in America. He became a target and they took him out. It was not that 22 year old kid.

Candace Owens is under threat from the Israeli government too. She gives them hell, but she does not have the pull he had, so they have not taken her out; they mess with her finances, and she was fired from the Daily Wire. But she loves white people, she loves her enemies, and when she speaks about the problems black people are dealing with, it is not to help her people but to appease her master. It was the same with Charlie Kirk: he spoke not to help the black community but to point out the evil we are doing. She might repent.

“They search out iniquities”: they say, who sees the evil that we are doing? There are things being done behind the scenes, and the man that was just assassinated saw something and understood something. That is why he was killed. And the Most High is behind that too.

precepts.why:
“For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.” If you know them, and know the evil they are doing, you are in the terrors of the shadow of death. But the time is coming when the Most High lifts us up and the world sees us, and when the people start listening to us in the hundreds of thousands and the millions, the same thing that happened to Charlie Kirk is going to happen to a lot of us. That is what we signed up for.

sense.text: “I am come to send fire on the earth”. That fire is destruction: Christ came to bring destruction on the earth. All the talk that Jesus loves everyone and Jesus is love is not it. Charlie Kirk’s death is one of the catalysts being used to start that fire.

“Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division”. Christ came to cause division. Charlie Kirk’s death is one of the catalysts to bring that division, and many other things are coming, where white people are going to say: I’m tired. All you do is commit crime and murder each other. Get off my land; this land is my land.

Hear how white people think. They say white people have been tolerant. For the last 60 years, since the civil rights, they sat back and watched what blacks and Hispanics would do with the so-called rights they were given, all the dumb, stupid, evil things, and now Trump is taking those rights back. These are white Christian nationalists, real Christians, not like you black people that call yourselves Christians and follow your oppressor’s religion, white supremacy. You are under the illusion that you are equal to white people.

And because he loves blood, blood shall follow him: they love war. They love war so much they practice it with war games when they are not at war, and they just changed the Department of Defense to the Department of War. The second amendment was not made for negroes; it was for white people to rise up and overthrow their government whenever they claim it no longer stands for them, and generations of ammunition are passed down among them, more than the National Guard. So you negroes that the liberals have got thinking you can fight the white man, you can’t. Their power is guns and weapons; our power is God, and God needs to turn us into something else.
“Why standest thou afar off, O Lord? why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?” God is hiding himself from our people.

“The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor”. The wicked is the white man, Esau, and he has been persecuting us for centuries now. “Let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined”: the same devices they imagine against us are going to fall upon them.

“He croucheth, and humbleth himself”. Who is it? The wicked, Esau. He makes himself look innocent and humble, and that is the liberals. They say we are equal, we are all one people, you want to be a transvestite, you can be a transvestite, freedom of speech, we will give you civil rights. They act like they are your friend, like they care about you. That is them crouching and humbling themselves, and the scripture says never trust your enemy even though he humbles himself. Everything the liberals set up was set up to destroy us, from section 8 to food stamps.

“That the poor may fall by his strong ones.” The poor is Israel. His strong ones are the rednecks, Esau, the ones storing up guns for decades, the Republicans, the politicians in high places, the FBI agents, the men that train for war. These liberals are going to lead you into a civil war. They say we are equal, we are all one, America is built on equality, and you will get carried away with that foolishness and go fight for them, and a lot of our brothers and sisters are going to die by their strong ones. David saw this in the spirit.

“The heaven shall reveal his iniquity”: the heaven shall reveal the evil that Israel and America are doing. “And the earth shall rise up against him”: the earth is going to rise up against the Israelis and America. That is the prophecy.

Last week the UN voted to recognize Palestinian statehood, and Australia, France and Britain, who were not supporting it before, said they would. All of a sudden there were mass protests and riots in France, in Britain, in Australia. Netanyahu claimed anti-semitism had surged in France after its decision, and Macron called that claim abject and erroneous; Netanyahu called Australia’s prime minister a weak politician who betrayed Israel. The European governments and their secret services are not stupid; they understand who is behind it. That evil is being revealed, and those nations will join together and rise up against Israel and America.

precepts.why:
“The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom”. “All the men of thy confederacy have brought thee even to the border: the men that were at peace with thee have deceived thee, and prevailed against thee; they that eat thy bread have laid a wound under thee”. The men of their confederacy are Europe. According to the prophecy, Europe will turn against Israel and America and prevail against them, and that is what you see taking place in Europe right now.

sense.text: “And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth”: that is America. “And is of the seven”, because America came from Britain. “And goeth into perdition”: America is going into destruction. America will be destroyed. In the Bible America is Mystery Babylon the Great.

They “have received no kingdom as yet”, at the time John the Revelator wrote it on the isle of Patmos, “but receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: Europe and America working together. That started after World War II.

“These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.” After World War II America formed the NATO alliance and the European Union; the Europeans had one mind and gave their power unto America.

“These shall make war with the Lamb”: according to Bible prophecy Europe is going to fight with Christ when he returns. They are not a Christian nation; they don’t love the Christ of the Bible, the God of this Bible. “And the Lamb shall overcome them”: Christ is going to destroy them, “for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings”.
“The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” That is America, sitting upon many nations and ruling many nations.

“The ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore”. The ten horns are Europe; remember Obadiah, thou art greatly despised. “And shall make her desolate and naked”: Europe is going to reveal America’s shame, a lot of the evil that America and the Israelis are doing. “And burn her with fire”, because that is the judgment for hoes: hoes got to be burned with fire, that is the law.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will”. That is God’s plan: God put it in Europe’s heart to destroy America. That is Bible prophecy. He had put it in their hearts “to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.” Now Europe is separating from America because of the policies Trump is putting in place. Pay attention to what is going on.
“That great city, which reigneth over the kings of the earth”: the great city ruling the earth today is America.

“Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east”. A couple of weeks ago the Israeli government attacked Qatar, an Arab nation. They had Qatar host the Hamas leaders, and when the Hamas leaders came together to discuss peace, they bombed them. Bombing a sovereign country is terrorism, or war. A man’s goings are of the Lord: that is God’s plan.

“Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.” That is the Arabs uniting and forming that NATO-style alliance, all the Arab countries coming together. By bombing Yemen, Lebanon, Syria and all these Arab countries, Netanyahu is uniting all the Arab nations. So we are not going to speak against what he is doing, because he is doing God’s plan. Keep doing what you’re doing, BB.

“Also the Carmanians raging in wrath”: the Carmanians are the Iranians, and they are going to join together with the Arabs. “With great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians”: they will waste a portion of the land of Israel.

“And then shall the dragons have the upper hand”: according to Bible prophecy the Arabs will get the upper hand on the Israelis over there. “Conspiring together in great power to persecute them”: to persecute the Israelis.
The Israelis are going to “keep silence through their power, and shall flee” when they see all the Arabs and Iran joined together. That is Bible prophecy, and that is God’s plan.

“When I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem”: the time when Christ comes and delivers us from these lands where we were made slaves. It shows that Judah and Israel are still in captivity. We are in the lands of our captivity.

“I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat”. God’s plan is for all nations to go down there into the land of Israel. Jehoshaphat means the valley of decision. “And will plead with them there”: he will destroy them there, “for my people”, you negroes, blacks and Hispanics, “and for my heritage Israel”, for what they did to us.

precepts.why:
“And in that day will I make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all people: all that burden themselves with it shall be cut in pieces”. Every nation that burdens itself with Israel, that says I want to go over there and help Israel, is going to be broken with it.

“Though all the people of the earth be gathered together against it.” All the people of the earth are going to be gathered together against Israel. That is Bible prophecy, the gathering of all nations into the valley of Jehoshaphat.

Some will say this happened to us back then, but it is future prophecy. “In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem”: that is us. “He that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David; and the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them”: the house of David is going to be as gods, as the angels of the Lord.

“I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.” God is going to destroy all the nations that fought against us, when Christ returns. That is the Lord pleading with the nations in the valley of Jehoshaphat for his people and his heritage Israel.

sense.text: “The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand”. Whatever God says is going to happen; his plans are going to come to pass.

“That I will break the Assyrian in my land”: the Assyrian in the land is the strangers in the land of Israel today, and God says he is going to break them, “and upon my mountains tread him under foot”.
“This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth”: that is God’s plan, to destroy the strangers in the land of Israel today.
“For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it?” Who can stop what he planned to do? “And his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?”

“Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina”: Palestina is the Palestinians over there today. “Because the rod of him that smote thee is broken”: the one smiting the Palestinians is the Israelis, the Assyrians in the land, strangers oppressing them. And this proves that Netanyahu will not be able to push them totally out of the land. France, Australia and Britain supporting a Palestinian state is for the Palestinians to stay in the land, while Trump and Netanyahu are trying to get them out. They destroyed the whole of Palestine thinking they would leave, starving them and saying let the other Arab countries take them, and they are only getting angrier. According to Bible prophecy, the Palestinians will stay in that land.

So, Netanyahu, what you are doing is fulfilling God’s will. You are making yourself and your people hated by everybody else; remember Obadiah, thou art greatly despised. When these things happen we don’t fight against it, because we understand prophecy: God’s plan is for everybody to hate Israel and America.

When is the rod broken? In 2 Esdras 15, when all the Arabs unite and destroy the Israelis. “For out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice”: the serpent’s root is America. “And his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent”: a fiery flying serpent is missiles.

“Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved”. They are going to be destroyed: America is going to drop a nuclear bomb on Palestine and destroy all the Palestinians. That is God’s plan. So the Palestinians are not going anywhere. They will stay in that land, and the Israeli government will put a yoke and restrictions on them and keep oppressing them.
“Thou, O king, art a king of kings: for the God of heaven hath given thee a kingdom, power, and strength, and glory.” “Thou art this head of gold”: the head of gold is ancient Babylon.

“And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee”: the Persians and the Medes, the East Indians and the modern-day Iranians. “And another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth”: the Greeks. When the Greeks, the white men, were ruling the earth, they were the third kingdom to rise up and rule.

“Whereas thou sawest the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay, and part of iron”: the feet and toes are the ending of the fourth kingdom, and that is where we are living right now. The feet and toes are the seven heads and ten horns in Revelation, the ending of the fourth beast: America and Europe. If you Christians say you believe the Bible, the Bible speaks of four kingdoms rising up to rule this earth before Christ comes and destroys them, so the people ruling the kingdom we live in now, Christ is coming to destroy.

“The kingdom shall be divided”: God’s plan was to make the ending part of this kingdom divided. “But there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”: militarily Europe and America are strong, but they are divided.

Why did Britain and America let all these immigrants into their countries? They were fulfilling Bible prophecy, because a man’s goings are of the Lord. If they could have looked back to 1948, they would have stopped it.

“So the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” We are living in a broken society, a broken kingdom, and white people say it too: their system is broken. Ever since 1948, when they let the immigrants, the Arabs and the East Indians come and live in their countries, they say we should never have done that. It is the same in America, with immigrants all over, in every facet of government.

“They shall mingle themselves with the seed of men”: the fourth beast is white people, the Europeans, the Caucasians, and they started mingling themselves with the seed of men after World War II. The last kingdom is a multicultural society. That is the iron mixed with miry clay: the rulers of this kingdom, white people, mixing with all nations, and because they did, their kingdom is broken. Now Trump is trying to fix that system, and the Europeans want to fix it; they want to make Europe white again and America white again. But God’s plan was to mix all nations there. A brother bore witness from the World War II films and documentaries: they show the mixing and the segregation, and yet they could not have won those wars without our people, our ingenuity and our intelligence. That too is the Most High’s plan.

“But they shall not cleave one to another”: everybody is not going to get along. Every nation that comes brings its own customs and follows them, the Arabs with their mosques and their own customs, and that is why the Europeans, and Trump and the white people in America, are getting mad: this is a Christian society, why are you bringing Allah here? Don’t listen to the lie that everybody is equal and everybody is one. According to God, they shall not cleave one to another.

The only people that have assimilated are blacks and Latinos. The Arab comes here and does not assimilate; he follows his god, sets up his community and keeps to his people. The Chinese keep their customs and their god. After the civil rights all nations came to America and mingled with the seed of men, and after 60 years they say our system is broken.

precepts.why:

precepts.why:
“He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity”. sense.text:

“Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your rest: because it is polluted, it shall destroy you”. This whole place is polluted, full of our abomination, filth and wickedness. The problem with a lot of brothers and sisters in America and Europe is that you think these places are the promised land: I made it, I’m in America. God says this place is not your rest.

There is a societal change taking place in America and in Europe. You were under the illusion that white people love you. We told you these people are the wicked of the earth, and you said we were racist. You are going to see that everything we have been saying for these last 20-some years is right.

“He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.” God’s plan is to deliver us in affliction, and he is going to open our ears with the oppressing sword, the oppressing sword that makes people say let us go back to our country, to the land of our nativity, rising up from the white nationalists and white Christian nationalists in Europe and America.

That is what is happening right now: God is opening our people’s ears for them to hear his word. After Charlie Kirk’s death a young man from Grenada, the Spice Island, who came here for the American dream, was found hanging from a tree in Mississippi, his foot broken and bruises all over him, and they call it a suicide. Truck drivers go missing in Mississippi and Georgia. In 2025 white people are singing about a short piece of rope, hanging them up high so the folks all know. Do you think white people love you? The oppressing sword is rising up right now. You brothers are weak: build yourselves up, don’t be a punk, protect your wives and your kids, and stop being simple.

So what is our job? We have to prophesy and teach. As affliction comes on our people, we have to teach them why these things are happening, because God is opening their ears to understand. In the next couple of years we are going to grow into the hundreds of thousands and millions, and the bishops can’t do it on their own, the deacons can’t, the captains can’t. You men have to rise up. You are here to become a better person, to overcome your lust and your sin and learn to deal with your brothers and sisters, so that you can teach the people that come after you. Don’t just come and sit in class every Saturday; do what you were sent here to do.

And learn to love yourselves. The problem with our people is that we want to be loved by everyone; we love our oppressors and hate ourselves, and that is from slavery. Love your people and your nation, and deal right with everybody else: deal right with white people, the Chinese and the Arabs, and don’t deal evil with them, but always prefer your people first. Charlie Kirk loved his people, Trump loves his people, and the Chinese, the Arabs and the Japanese love their people. If you loved yourself you would not be offended at what Charlie Kirk said about the gang violence, and the section 8 housing the liberals used to destroy us; that is us hating ourselves. Stop killing each other. Let them be patriots for their countries, and we will be patriots for ours, the kingdom of heaven, Jerusalem. A patriot is somebody that loves his people and his land.
